annotations.title: Venue guide: bags, entry, parking, food

description:
What to know before going to a venue, from UPFRONT's venue guide:
the bag policy and what fans can bring, gates and entry, parking,
getting there by transit or rideshare, and food and drink,
including what the guide says about gluten-free, vegetarian or
vegan, halal and kosher food. Matches questions like "what's the
bag policy at MetLife?", "when do doors open at MSG?" or "where do
I park for Lambeau?".

venue: the venue's name ("MetLife Stadium", "MSG", "Lumen Field,
Seattle").
topics: optional; only these parts, at more length: any of "bags",
"entry", "parking", "transit", "food". Without it, every part.

Covers the 36 stadiums, arenas and amphitheaters UPFRONT has a
guide for; for any other venue the answer says so and lists the
ones with guides.

Each part is the guide's own words ("text", plus the guide's "faq"
questions and answers). factsLastChecked is the date UPFRONT last
checked the guide's facts; rules can change for a single event, and
the venue's own event page has the final word. guideUrl is the
guide on UPFRONT. dietary lists what the guide says per diet;
dietaryNotMentioned lists diets the guide doesn't cover, which
doesn't mean the venue has nothing for them.
